description: CI gate: legacy repo paths must not read as current SSOT without same-line deprecation markers.

rules.description: Legacy single-file staking removed; SSOT is IdentityStakingPool + Guide/Provider pools.
rules.allow_line_fallback_regex: 已移除|已删除|已下线|已从仓库|已从树|removed\s+from|no\s+longer|legacy|obsolete|deprecated|historical|审计时点|不得|仅作历史|历史兼容|旧单文件|旧版|旧\s*`|`\s*旧|向后兼容|compatible|该文件已移除|叙述下线|与历史|静默.*旧|旧.*Staking\.sol|Staking\.sol.*已移除|contracts/src/Staking.*已移除|已移除.*contracts/src/Staking
rules.suggestion: SSOT: contracts/src/IdentityStakingPool.sol + GuideIdentityStakingPool.sol / ProviderIdentityStakingPool.sol (ABI: contracts/abi/GuideIdentityStakingPool.json, ProviderIdentityStakingPool.json). If you must mention the removed file, keep removed/legacy/已移除/旧 on the same line (see allow_structured_regexes in config/ci/legacy_path_ssot_rules.v1.json).

rules.description: Duplicate this object, set enabled true, and fill hit_regexes / allow_structured_regexes / allow_line_fallback_regex / suggestion for other retired paths.
